newsitem.title: USA: Entergy Miss. nuke expected on line Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Entergy Miss. nuke expected on line Thurs.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 1,173 megawatt Grand Gulf 1 nuclear power plant will likely synchronize to the electricity grid Thursday morning, returning from a scheduled maintenance outage, a spokeswoman said Wednesday.
"It is expected to synchronize to the grid tomorrow morning," said spokeswoman Diane Park.
The Port Gibson, Miss., plant was shut Oct 19 for refueling and maintenance.
The unit is expected to take several days to reach full power, as several restart tests are required during power ascension, the spokeswoman said.
